_about: Public-domain John Dobree (Bernard) Dalgairns (1818-1876), Oratorian priest, for the Word Hoard: his Life of St Gilbert for the Lives of the English Saints (the unsigned lives of St Stephen Harding and St Aelred are held), The Devotion to the Heart of Jesus, The German Mystics of the Fourteenth Century, The Holy Communion: its Philosophy, Theology and Practice, and The Bearing of Infallibility on Religious Truth. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-24 by lane A, round 137 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

dalgairns-gilbert: Life of Saint Gilbert, Prior of Sempringham (catalogued 1844)
dalgairns-sacred-heart: The devotion to the Heart of Jesus ; with an introduction on the history of Jansenism (London : T. Richardson and Son, 1853)
dalgairns-german-mystics: The German mystics of the fourteenth century (London : T. Richardson, 1858)
dalgairns-holy-communion: The Holy Communion : Its philosophy, theology and practice (Dublin : James Duffy, 1868)
dalgairns-infallibility: The bearing of infallibility on religious truth ([London? : s.n., 1871)
